<MethodEndpoint method={'post'} path={'/v1/admin/agreements'} context={'endpoint'}></MethodEndpoint>

Derives the next version of the family `key` names, `1` for a family nobody has published yet, and links it as pending to every onboarding whose accepted version is now behind, notifying each through its own workflow's notify webhook. `type` belongs to the family, so a publish under an existing key with a different type is refused. There is no content and no name: a version is identity and number only.
